control_note: A revision that cannot exist must return 404. If this control returns 200 the probe cannot tell a real revision from a soft-404 catch-all; if it returns anything other than 404 the read failed and no absence may be inferred from any other 404 here.
probe_method: curl -sSL against the published specification site; statuses are after redirects

required_tool_fields.note: Read from schema.ts at each revision: Tool extends BaseMetadata (name required, title optional); description, outputSchema, annotations, _meta and (2026-07-28) icons are all optional. A minimal derived contract is therefore structurally valid under both revisions and its token count does not move with the pin.

tool_definition_surface_growth.measured_on: the rendered server/tools page of each revision
tool_definition_surface_growth.note: Occurrences of each optional Tool field on the revision's own server/tools page. The newer revision documents a materially larger optional surface, which is why a minimal derived contract is a floor and not a typical figure.
